title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
summary_en: This article discusses recent major breakthroughs in mathematics achieved by AI models from OpenAI and Anthropic. OpenAI's upcoming model solved ten difficult math problems that had seen no progress for over a decade. The author also explores how mathematicians are reacting to these changes and what the future of human-AI collaboration might look like.
summary_zh: 本文介紹了 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 在數學與電腦科學領域的最新 AI 進展。OpenAI 宣稱其下一代模型 Astra 成功解決了十個懸而未決十多年的數學難題，且成本相對低廉。文章也探討了數學家對 AI 介入研究的焦慮，以及數學大師陶哲軒對於人機協作「大數學」時代的願景。

scan_questions.question: Which internal version of the model did OpenAI use to solve the math problems?
scan_questions.answer_zh: OpenAI 使用了名為 Astra 的內部版本，這是他們的下一個主要模型。

scan_questions.question: What is the name of the GitHub repository containing the formalizations of OpenAI's results?
scan_questions.answer_zh: 該儲存庫的名稱為 openai/ten-proofs。

scan_questions.question: How much did Anthropic spend on tokens to discover cryptographic weaknesses with Claude?
scan_questions.answer_zh: Anthropic 花費了 10 萬美元的代幣。

paragraphs.translation: 2026 年 8 月 1 日 - 連結部落格

paragraphs.text: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science (via) A few days ago it was Anthropic discovering cryptographic weaknesses with Claude using Mythos Preview, spending $100,000 on tokens and with prompts that included "again we are not looking for low hanging fruit, we want proper research to find genuinly hard findings."
paragraphs.translation: 「數學與理論電腦科學的十項進展」（轉載）。幾天前，Anthropic 揭露了使用 Claude 的 Mythos Preview 版本發現了加密技術的弱點，花費了 10 萬美元的代幣，且使用的提示詞包含：「再次強調，我們不是在找簡單的目標，我們想要真正的研究來發現真正困難的發現。」

paragraphs.text: Now it's OpenAI's turn to flex. They set "an internal version of Astra, our next major model" on finding solutions to ten mathematical problems that "have seen no progress on the main result for at least a decade". They claim to have spent less than $2,000 at GPT-5.6 Sol token prices on each one.
paragraphs.translation: 現在輪到 OpenAI 展示實力了。他們讓「Astra 的內部版本，即我們的下一個主要模型」去尋找十個數學問題的解答，這些問題「在主要結果上至少十年沒有進展」。他們聲稱在每個問題上花費的 GPT-5.6 Sol 代幣價格低於 2,000 美元。

paragraphs.text: (No news on how many problems they spent $2,000 on without reaching a solution though.)
paragraphs.translation: （不過，沒有關於他們在「未」達成解決方案的情況下，對多少個問題各花了 2,000 美元的消息。）

paragraphs.text: The openai/ten-proofs repository has Lean 4 formalizations of their results, and there's also a paper describing the solutions and an additional LLM-generated PDF where the model "reconstructs how the proof came together" based on the unpublished reasoning traces.
paragraphs.translation: openai/ten-proofs 儲存庫中有其結果的 Lean 4 形式化證明，還有一篇描述解決方案的論文，以及一份額外由大型語言模型（LLM）生成的 PDF，該模型根據未公開的推理軌跡「重建了證明是如何組合而成的」。

paragraphs.text: That's a decent level of transparency, but I want to see the prompts they used!
paragraphs.translation: 這是一個不錯的透明度水平，但我更想看到他們使用的提示詞！

paragraphs.text: A lot of mathematicians online are experiencing a collective burst of Deep Blue. Mathematician Kirwin Hampshire published an impassioned essay last week, The Dark Night of Mathematics, describing "a profound spiritual crisis" brought on by previous (and less significant) results.
paragraphs.translation: 許多網路上的數學家正在經歷一場集體的「深藍」時刻。數學家 Kirwin Hampshire 上週發表了一篇慷慨激昂的文章《數學的暗夜》，描述了由先前（且較不顯著）的結果所帶來的「深刻的精神危機」。

paragraphs.text: OpenAI's results reminds me of what Terence Tao described as "big mathematics" in IEEE Spectrum in June:
paragraphs.translation: OpenAI 的結果讓我想起 Terence Tao（陶哲軒）六月份在 IEEE Spectrum 中描述的「大數學」：

paragraphs.text: Unlike some of his peers, Tao is neither dismissive of AI nor fearful. Instead, he sees it as the catalyst for a fundamental shift in the discipline—a transition toward what he calls “big mathematics.” He envisions a future of large-scale, decentralized collaborations between humans and machines, where complex mathematical tasks can be diced and sliced, with humans claiming the creative parts and AI doing the lion’s share of the technical grunt work.
paragraphs.translation: 與一些同行不同，Tao 既不輕視 AI，也不感到恐懼。相反，他將其視為學科根本轉變的催化劑——向他所謂的「大數學」轉型。他設想了一個由人類與機器進行大規模、去中心化協作的未來，其中複雜的數學任務可以被細分，由人類負責創意部分，而 AI 承擔大部分的技術性繁重苦差事。
